lane: co-training, disagreement as the discovery signal
qualification: pinned owner-mirror bytes, SHA-verified; not organizer-authenticated

independence.negative_class: held-out catalogue-zero proxies, not verified absence
independence.reason: weak proxy negative-error correlation; not proof of conditional feature independence

leakage_canary.verdict: no single layer exceeds AUC 0.90 on the holdout; no leakage detected at this granularity

A_labels_B.rule: whole 8-connected segments inside one 50x50 block, entirely inside the fold-0 fit region (>=400 m buffer around every held segment), never on a catalogue or corridor pixel; donor confident, receiver in the abstention band; donor labels the OTHER view

B_labels_A.rule: whole 8-connected segments inside one 50x50 block, entirely inside the fold-0 fit region (>=400 m buffer around every held segment), never on a catalogue or corridor pixel; donor confident, receiver in the abstention band; donor labels the OTHER view

disagreement_fields.dis_product: `pA * (1 - pB)`: large iff View A is confident AND View B abstains.
disagreement_fields.dis_contrast: `max(pA - pB, 0)`: the additive form of the same disagreement cell.
disagreement_fields.dis_B_product: `pB * (1 - pA)`: the B-only stratum — suspect surface artifacts (roads, levees,
